external_engine.role: exact undirected Feedback Vertex Set proposal engine
external_engine.pedigree: winner of PACE 2016 Feedback Vertex Set exact challenge
external_engine.implementation_claim: default FPTBranchingSolver with O*(4^k) parameter dependence
external_engine.certificate: returned vertex set X; independent verification checks incidence graph minus X is acyclic

composition.input: CNF incidence graph G with maximum clause width d
composition.external_witness: feedback vertex set X of G
composition.conversion: Y=(X intersect variable-vertices) union, for each clause-vertex C in X, all variable neighbors N(C)
proof: Every clause-vertex C replaced from X has all its neighbors in Y, so C is isolated in G-Y.
Any cycle in G-Y therefore avoids every clause-vertex originally in X.
It also avoids variable-vertices originally in X because those are included in Y.
Hence any cycle in G-Y would be a cycle in G-X, contradicting that X is an FVS.
composition.consequence: G-Y is a forest. Since assigning Y only removes further clauses/edges from the incidence graph, every residual F[tau] has acyclic incidence graph. Thus Y is a strong Forest deletion backdoor.
composition.polynomial_condition: For fixed d, if k=|X|=O(log n), public O*(4^k) FVS discovery and at most 2^(d*k) assignment routing to polynomial Forest-SAT are polynomial in n.

positive_technology: accepts DIMACS CNF and computes signed twin-width/contraction sequences
repository contains a proof_checker.py for contraction-sequence verification
signed_twin_width_kill_switch.theory_limit: SAT 2022 proves FPT for Bounded-ones Weighted Model Counting parameterized by certified signed twin-width plus the bounded-ones parameter k.
signed_twin_width_kill_switch.forbidden_inference: Bounded signed twin-width alone is not a tractability island for unrestricted SAT; the paper reports paraNP-hardness when the bounded-ones parameter is unrestricted.
signed_twin_width_kill_switch.possible_use: diagnostic / auxiliary structural certificate only unless another independently bounded parameter restores tractability
